summary: Nakamoto Inc. filed an 8-K on May 4, 2026, disclosing the board's approval and entry into revised director and officer indemnification agreements with all current directors and officers. These agreements update prior forms, providing indemnification to the fullest extent under Delaware law, advancement of expenses within 30 days of written request, and a presumption in favor of indemnification. No monetary terms, premiums, or specific transactions are involved; the filing is a standard governance update. This is not a special situation — it reflects ordinary prophylactic corporate housekeeping with no event-driven catalyst or risk-arb angle.
